commonEnvironmentTransfer.commonEnvironment: Same native1.24 shell-free Board/budget,180 Coins; coach,Focus,dead-end warning,causal cues and companions all hidden/disabled for every training condition and cold reference.
commonEnvironmentTransfer.reset: Fatigue/frustration/memory reset; only final learned rule state transplanted. Policy feedback continues during each probe; different campaign exposure remains.

method.arrivals: Later levels condition on actually arriving trajectories; retry starts retained.
method.firstAttempts: Matched profile/repetition first arrivals at U27/U43/U48; common-arrival selection and different prior exposure remain.
method.historical: Gameplay AND episodic-memory model change versus1.23;new seed.No causal before/after release claim.
method.learning: Common four-rule state is an uncalibrated model variable. Probe differences do not establish human cognition.
method.manual: Tap execution may follow native cues. Exact direct-cue-follow events counted separately; absence of a cue on one action does not prove no prior help.
method.negativeMemory: Agent124 scopes episodic negatives to actual native board+visible geometry in all four cohorts;rule learning remains transferable.
method.oracle: 104 engine certification boards separate from all8000 limited-perception trajectories.
method.ownership: Fresh starter Nova; loaned trio separate; acquisition,UI and Android persistence excluded.
method.pooledRates: Exact numerators/denominators; distinguish from mean per-trajectory rates in paired JSON.
method.probes: Same shell-free budget/geometry/no-aid environment in all regimes and cold reference; only final learned state transplanted.8000 cold rows reused as reference, not reexecuted four times.
method.quantiles: Sorted observed values at indexround((n-1)*q),no interpolation;descriptive synthetic cohorts.
method.rankMotivation: No added willingness-to-play bonus from XP/copies is assumed.
method.returns: Availability,utility,modeledD1/D7 and decision timing are assumptions, not human retention or speed.
